sanskrit_verse:
हीनजातौ प्रजायेत पररत्नापहारकः ।
पत्रशाकं शिखी हत्वा गन्धान् छुच्छुन्दरी शुभान् ॥
transliteration: hīnajātau prajāyeta pararatnāpahārakaḥ | patraśākaṃ śikhī hatvā gandhān chucchundarī śubhān ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One born of a low caste who seizes another's jewels, having killed a peacock for its feathers and plucked auspicious blossoms from the chuchchhunda creeper — such a being arises from degraded origin yet commits acts of appropriation rooted in sensory indulgence.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority stems from purity of birth and action, not mere social position.
Causation flows through intent-laden sensory engagement.
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with dharma-sustained consciousness.
Restoration logic demands purification of desire-driven impulses.
Consciousness alignment necessitates transcendence of material covetousness.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving individuals of contested lineage or status, the court shall assess not the accident of birth alone but the alignment of conduct with dharmic capacity. Where appropriation is driven by aesthetic or sensual craving, punitive measures are replaced by protocols ensuring sensory discipline and spiritual recalibration.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that misdeeds stem from distorted perception of value; thus, corrective action follows causal sequence: distorted desire → sensory fixation → wrongful taking. Responsibility aligns proportionally to the degree of consciousness obscured, not to inflict pain but to restore clarity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Sensory Detoxification Process to dissolve attachment to external beauty.
Assign Dharmic Identity Reassertion Program to reaffirm svadharma.
Enforce Aesthetic Renunciation Rituals to redirect attraction toward inner luminosity.
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: neither degradation nor transgression is eternal, for consciousness may always be restored. Dharma prevails beyond caste and craving. Reality remains non-punitive, governed solely by the awakening of pure awareness.
